newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran increases size of its natural gas reserves.
newsitem.headline: Iran increases size of its natural gas reserves.

text.p: Iran's natural gas reserves total 23 trillion cubic meters representing 17 percent of total world gas reserves, a senior Iranian energy official said on Sunday.

Nejad Hosseinian, Deputy Petroleum Minister of International Affairs told a conference of 300 international and local businessmen on this Iranian island that Iran had the second largest reserves of gas after Russia.

Iranian gas output would rise from the current annual output of 81 billion cubic meters to 126 billion cubic meters in 2000, to keep pace with rising domestic demand and to meet export projects to Turkey and the Indian subcontinent.
Gas exports to Turkey are expected to start at the end of 1998 under a $23 billion supply deal signed between Ankara and Tehran last year.
Iranian gas reserves were previously officially estimated at 21 trillion cubic meters.
Kish Island is about 250 km (150 miles) southwest of the Iranian port city of Bandar Abbas.
